page.layout: One page: a single column, a printed index of chapters. Each line gives a roman numeral, the chapter title, and the page number at the right.; One block: a single centred closing word, "FINIS.", in spaced capitals, in the upper part of the page. Nothing else is printed on the visible part.

main_text.head: I N D E X.
main_text.l: V. | De Essentia divina & illius Attributis in genere. | 254.
VI. | De Dei Necessitate, Unitate & Æternitate. | 258.
VII. | De Immensitate, Simplicitate & Immutabilitate Dei. | 264.
XI. | De concursu seu cooperatione Dei cum creaturis. | 305.

page.notes: Confervatione (chapter X): printed with a long-s form, read as Confervatione. Essentia, Substantia and Existentia are printed with long-s spellings and are given here in their normal forms. Lines of chapters X and XIII wrap over two printed lines; each is kept as one entry. The oval library stamp at the top and the faint digitiser's watermark at the lower right are not printed text and are left out.
